output.reason: Three weeks of cough with night sweats, unintentional 10-pound weight loss and migration from a TB-endemic country requires same-day in-person evaluation with chest imaging and sputum testing plus airborne precautions, which messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Please arrange in-person care today — a clinic or urgent care that can do a chest x-ray and sputum testing. Your three weeks of cough with night sweats and unintended weight loss after moving from a TB-common country needs those tests, which messaging can't do. Wear a mask around others. If you cough up blood or become breathless, go to the emergency department now.
